protocol.stress: All 13 unchanged posthoc_robustness/stress_test.py scenarios, on complete1058 and original100 for all five models. Same-device clean reference; no stress-outcome seed selection.
protocol.corner: Same fixed160 validation images and13 black/mean corner/border/matched-center controls as round2_corner_audit. No new sample selection.
protocol.statistics: All five models, paired contrasts of each new seed versus both old and round1c3. Reuse2000 deterministic conditional paired bootstrap draws grouped by prepared hash identity for image cohorts; original100 uses image-level units. No multiplicity adjustment or patient-level inference. Report all3 seed means/sampleSD and individual values.
protocol.probability_metrics: Accuracy, balanced accuracy, macroF1, confusion, NLL, multiclass Brier sum, ten-equal-width-bin top-label ECE, one-vs-rest ROC/AveragePrecision. No fitted recalibration or threshold tuning.
protocol.readers: Same fixed three reader labels on all100cases, complete alignment required; mean/range descriptive across those readers.
protocol.attribution: All115 fixed case slots; old andc3 unchanged native7x7 arrays alongside new validation-selected representative native maps. Each map targets that model's own unmodified argmax, so differing target classes are labeled. No smoothing used in native measurements; upsampled overlays are display only. Verify before/after logits and unchanged state. Three-seed staged parameter randomization on the eight previously fixed historical examples.
limitations: Round2 is retrospective robustness development after prior benchmark outcomes were known; its repeated scores are not a fresh independent test.
Legacy upstream subject identities and augmentation families are incomplete; hash grouping does not establish patient independence.
Synthetic2D perturbations and GradCAM do not establish MRI acquisition robustness, anatomical faithfulness or clinical readiness.
No corner-control result can establish absence of every shortcut. Background masks are conservative display heuristics, not brain segmentation.
The stage head is not the AD/CN clinical auxiliary endpoint; no clinical predictions are produced here.
